capabilities: Define note sets from tags, folders, frontmatter properties, dates, or dataviewJS queries
Review notes in order or randomly from a persistent queue via sidebar buttons or commands
Skip notes or reset a noteset queue to start a fresh review
Set per-note review frequency (high, normal, low, ignore)
Show noteset stats in settings and the sidebar
disambiguation: Not a spaced repetition plugin; it resurfaces notes at your own pace with no schedule.
extras: The README warns that review queues do not update automatically and should be reset when starting a new review.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to systematically revisit existing notes, and spaced repetition tools impose a fixed schedule many users do not want.

relations.evidence: this plugin uses Dataview plugin as its search engine

summary: Self-paced note review plugin that builds note sets and persistent review queues for resurfacing and revisiting notes.
